Policies and Initiatives.title: Day of double disappointment for Punjab: Rana KP on Union Budget, PM’s visit
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Rana KP Singh criticized the Union Budget 2024 for not addressing Punjab's needs. He also expressed disappointment over Prime Minister Modi's visit to the state, citing the lack of special announcements. The omission and lack of announcements have been deemed a double disappointment for Punjab.
